title: Night Train 404 — Part 1
style: stylized 3D cartoon detective story, soft cel shading, cinematic noir lighting, night train interior, deep blue shadows and warm amber lamps, muted palette, vertical 9:16, no text

shots.narration: She got on the train. She never got off.
shots.prompt: empty train seat at night, a woman's coat left on it, suitcase on the floor, dark window with passing lights

shots.narration: Night train 404. No stops for two hours.
shots.say: Night train four oh four. No stops for two hours.
shots.prompt: night train crossing a stone bridge over a valley under a full moon, lit windows

shots.say: At eleven forty, Clara Weiss took seat fifteen.
shots.prompt: close-up of a train ticket and a pocket watch on a fold-down table

shots.narration: At midnight, her husband started screaming for help.
shots.prompt: man in a suit shouting in a narrow train corridor, emergency handle, harsh light

shots.narration: Her seat was empty. Her coat was still warm.
shots.prompt: close-up of a coat on a train seat with a steaming cup of tea beside it

shots.narration: Every door was locked. Every window, sealed.
shots.prompt: locked train door with a red lock light, rain on the window

shots.narration: Then the conductor said something strange.
shots.prompt: train conductor in a peaked cap holding a lantern in a dark corridor, face in shadow
passenger list on a clipboard, seat 15 circled in red

shots.narration: But her suitcase was still here.
shots.prompt: old leather suitcase alone in a train aisle under a flashlight beam
close-up of a leather suitcase, red glow, sense of a ticking sound

shots.narration: And on the foggy window, someone had written two letters.
shots.prompt: fogged train window with the letters HE written by a finger, rain outside

shots.narration: Detective, you decide. Open the suitcase, or question the conductor? Comment A or B.
shots.prompt: split screen: a suitcase on top, a conductor's cap below
